correctness.rationale: Independent differentiation of the Cartesian field and symbolic expansion confirm c_2,c_1,c_0, the completed square, all three highest-degree terms of (c_2 c_1−c_0)/μ, and κ_1. The cubic criterion with c_0,c_2>0 is sufficient as well as necessary: c_1>0 follows from c_2c_1>c_0. c_2 has a uniform positive lower bound for small μ; c_0 is positive outside a compact set by positive definite leading forms of f_3,f_4, and on the compact set by g→10 uniformly. Dividing H by s²(1+μs²+μ²s⁴) gives a convex combination of strictly positive leading forms on the unit semicircle, with uniform O(1/s) error. Thus no zeros or near-zero minima can escape to infinity. Near the limiting unique interior minimizer (10/sqrt(62),1/(2sqrt(62))) the Hessian is positive definite, and outside that neighborhood the limiting square gives a positive compact gap. The analytic minimizer has value with κ-derivative u_0/5, giving a local analytic strict threshold; its first correction is −5P_2/u_0=428.396613755040596…>0. At equality the positive cubic coefficients yield (λ+c_2)(λ²+c_1) exactly on a single u>0 orbit of rotation. For fixed κ away from κ_0 the leading sign is decided on the compact region using the same tail bound (or by a negative value at the limiting minimizer); at κ_0 the first correction excludes strict Hurwitz. On z=−u/10, S=−25(u−1)(u−4)/21, yielding the two period-2π circles and opposite signs of the transverse Jacobian determinant; the trace at u=4 is negative for small μ.
residual_risks: The exact analytic iff concerns a fixed interval around κ_0 at small positive μ; it is not a global finite-parameter diagram. The equality circle is a locus of pointwise Jacobian spectra, not asserted to be a flow orbit.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Broader cycle classification does not imply pointwise stability of the Cartesian Jacobian. Local robustness at one parameter pair and gauge comparison do not dominate a sharp small-μ threshold for every point in the fixed field.

The original field, two cycles, cubic coefficients and a globally Hurwitz open set are prior. value.rationale: The known counterexample is specified by an isolated certified pair plus an unspecified open region. A necessary and sufficient local shear boundary across all space identifies how the counterexample can stay everywhere Hurwitz as dissipation vanishes. The first correction decides the critical fixed ray itself, and the equality locus describes how strict stability fails. These are structural refinements of a motivated stability problem, not arbitrary parameter tuning.
residual_risks: Does not solve the finite-μ global diagram or determine basin changes or stability at other parameters.
